content.title: Sonida to Create One of America’s Largest Senior Housing Firms in Merger
content.summary: Sonida Senior Living  said Wednesday that it had agreed to acquire a smaller rival in a $1.8 billion deal that would create one of the country’s largest senior housing companies.  The senior housing business is emerging as one of the hottest in the commercial real-estate sector, recovering from a devastating slump that lasted for years.  A glut of new supply and collapse in demand during the pandemic caused occupancy rates to tumble and many senior housing facilities to shut down.
